title: Spanish h disappears
voice_notes: Warm, patient teacher. One voice. Brian v3. English prompts use language_code en; Spanish reveals use language_code es. Avoid Language Transfer branding.

segments.say: Spanish has one letter you should completely ignore.
The letter h is written, but it does not make a sound.
C H together still makes the ch sound. But a plain h disappears.
segments.show:
ch is different
plain h disappears

segments.say: Do not even give it a tiny breath. Imagine the word starts with the next vowel.
segments.show:
no breath
start at the vowel

segments.say: Try the word hospital, with no h sound.
And if you add mente, the h still stays silent.
The word for now also hides one of these silent h's.
Good. The letter is there for your eyes, not your mouth.
segments.show:
for your eyes
not your mouth

caption: Spanish h is silent: hospital, horrible, habitual, habitualmente, ahora. See it, but do not pronounce it.
